Name: No More Bowlegs
Author: Chrysanthe
Description:
[size=5]No More Bowlegs[/size]
[color=#e06666][b]Updated for SDV ver 1.4 and now compatible with CP.[/b][/color]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/5OCftX5.png[/img]        [img]http://i.imgur.com/RPTpbh0.png[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/cFUgTjS.png/<img src=[/img]
Abigail, Leah & Maru will no longer have bow legs with these mods.
Let me know if you find any errors or stray pixels. Thanks.

[b][u][size=3]Instructions for SMAPI & CP:[/size][/u][/b]
. [url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url] and then [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
. Download this mod and unzip the folder it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
. Run the game using SMAPI.

[i] I will upload the .xnb files if there are enough requests.[/i]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/SGwq53h.gif[/img]    [img]http://i.imgur.com/Xzs0ZbZ.gif[/img]

[b]4/28:[/b] Leah is also done and available. Meanwhile, enjoy the view from the back..
[img]http://i.imgur.com/fVa3EJd.gif[/img]      [img]http://i.imgur.com/gB2GGZF.gif[/img]

[b]5/7:[/b] [b]Walknoot [/b]has requested a version of Abigail without her bow so I've added that as an optional file.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/RiRu0CC.gif[/img]

[b]6/28: [/b]Releasing Maru without bowlegs due to popular request.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/FIrFOnj.gif[/img]     [img]http://i.imgur.com/kI0L3MN.gif[/img]     [img]https://i.imgur.com/9seZHLM.png[/img]     [img]http://i.imgur.com/iyFykl7.gif[/img]
I made some tweaks to her hair as well as the back of her overalls to my preference.
[b]NEW: [/b]Edited the back of her sprite again on version [1.1.0]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZiK13gc.gif[/img]

[b]1/23/17: [/b]Emily's version has been released. The difference is less drastic though since so little of her legs revealed. Also I did not change any of her dancing scenes.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/BcJjFav.gif[/img]

[b]1/26/17[/b]: Jodi's version is released! Her sprite has also been tweaked for a slimmer look, and her head no longer looks like its floating.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/96DqrgG.gif[/img]     [img]http://i.imgur.com/emGEkra.gif[/img]   [img]http://i.imgur.com/BLFlQI4.png[/img]
[b]1/22/20:[/b] NEW Version [1.1.0] with Jodi's back hair edited to look more like the front.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/y7TMS1Y.gif[/img]

[b]1/28 Update:[/b] Added Maru in her nurse outfit as optional file. Fixed an error in her back animation too.
There is now a zip file for all the edited sprites made so far for your convenience (except Abigail without Bow).


[b][u][size=3]Instructions (OUTDATED):[/size][/u][/b]
. This mod replaces the original .xnb sprites for any of the characters you have downloaded. Please make a backup of the original file(s) if necessary.
. Unzip or extract the [i].xnb[/i] file after downloading.
. Place the file(s) into the Stardew Valley folder under [i]Content\Characters.[/i]

Happy downloading :D
Let me know if there are other requests.

Downloads.Description: Contains the sprites for Abigail, Leah, Maru (& Hospital Maru), Emily and Jodi. Now updated for ver 1.4 and compatible with CP.

Manifest.Name: No More Bowlegs
Manifest.Description: Removes bow-leggedness on Abigail, Leah, Maru and Emily's sprites. No more gaps between their legs.
Manifest.Author: Chrysanthe
